authentication.participant: Master ID + registered phone; signed 30-minute shared participant session

notes: Public package contains participant-facing routes only; Admin/Master UI remains separate.
Participant access token is HMAC-signed and expires exactly 30 minutes after successful verification or Master ID creation.
The same valid participant session is reused across Event Registration and Abstract Submission portals.
Abstract submission is allowed only for an event the participant is actually registered for and configured/recognized as submission-based.
Netlify function entrypoints delegate to the shared API handlers; no duplicate broken abstract wrapper remains.
Supabase service-role credentials are not bundled.
Created a standalone profile portal and removed profile UI/state from event registration portal.
